verdict.rationale: Reclaim is a SaaS calendar assistant, so headless or programmatic automation is a fair question to ask of it. The only programmatic surface in evidence is a live, first-party remote MCP endpoint at mcp.reclaim.ai: it requires OAuth bearer-token auth and advertises read/write scopes (probe-rt-1, rt-2). That offers a plausible route to non-UI automation, but no vendor docs for it exist, OpenAPI paths all 404, and nothing shows a CLI or CI usage. missing for 10: documented public API or CLI, non-interactive/service-account auth suitable for CI, vendor docs for the MCP server, any hands-on evidence of headless or CI automation.
